name: color-code
description: /color themes the whole Claude Code session: a matching contrast-checked theme (dark or light), the terminal tab's background and palette, and a tab ring showing working / waiting on you / idle. Windows Terminal, macOS and Linux terminals.

activity.title: Tab activity ring
activity.description: Show in the terminal tab whether Claude is working (spinning ring), waiting on you (yellow ring) or idle. Windows Terminal, ConEmu and Ghostty.

autoColor.title: Auto color per project
autoColor.description: Give a session nobody colored a stable color picked from its project folder.
